response.text: {"label": "protocol_misunderstanding", "reason": "The sub assumes a frame with a low stop bit still latches 3C into m_axis_tdata with tvalid high, but the receiver discards bad frames, so its single bad 3C frame only gives `384 ... rx frame_error 1` with no word held. Its A5 frame therefore never overruns (no overrun_error before `765 ... rx busy_fall`), whereas gold has `230 ... rx overrun_error 1`."}
